sources.title: Powder Metallurgy Processes
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 熱等靜壓緻密化
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體積與線性縮放分開，金屬質量可追溯，且不以平均密度宣稱所有孔隙已消失。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Separate linear and volume scaling, trace metal mass, and do not infer pore elimination from average density.
related.difference: 辨認密度提升、內部缺陷閉合與表面連通孔之間的證據差異。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish evidence for bulk density, internal defect closure and surface-connected pores.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相同金屬質量下 Vfinal/Vinitial=ρinitial/ρfinal；等向線性比為體積比的立方根。 教學金屬粉體骨架相對密度從 0.75 到 0.95，初始長度 20 mm，忽略氧化與各向異性。 V比=0.75/0.95=0.78947；Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm，線收縮約 7.58%。
以實體材料密度為基準，相對密度=1−孔隙體積率；相同金屬質量下尺寸變化須由體積比推導。 教學試片前後孔隙率為 2.0% 與 0.2%，初始體積 100 cm³，假設金屬質量不變。 Vafter=100×0.98/0.998=98.1964 cm³；體積下降 1.8036%，不能直接當成線收縮。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At fixed metal mass Vfinal/Vinitial=ρ initial/ρ final; isotropic linear ratio is the cube root of that volume ratio. Teaching relative density increases from 0.75 to 0.95; initial length 20 mm; neglect oxidation and anisotropy. Volume ratio=0.75/0.95=0.78947; Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm, approximately 7.58% linear shrinkage.

Relative density equals one minus void fraction on a solid-material basis; fixed-mass size change follows the volume ratio. Teaching porosity is 2.0% before and 0.2% after; initial volume 100 cm³ with unchanged metal mass. Vafter=100×0.98/0.998=98.1964 cm³; volume decreases 1.8036%, which is not the linear contraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 粉末冶金齒輪製造
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：體積與線性縮放分開，金屬質量可追溯，且不以平均密度宣稱所有孔隙已消失。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Separate linear and volume scaling, trace metal mass, and do not infer pore elimination from average density.
related.difference: 以環形近似核對齒輪坯重量，將齒根局部孔隙與整體密度分開驗收。
related.differenceEn: Check blank mass with an annular approximation and assess local tooth-root porosity separately from bulk density.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 相同金屬質量下 Vfinal/Vinitial=ρinitial/ρfinal；等向線性比為體積比的立方根。 教學金屬粉體骨架相對密度從 0.75 到 0.95，初始長度 20 mm，忽略氧化與各向異性。 V比=0.75/0.95=0.78947；Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm，線收縮約 7.58%。
環形體積 V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4，質量 m=ρsolid×relative density×V；齒槽另扣。 合成等效環形外徑 60 mm、內徑 20 mm、寬 10 mm；實體密度 7.8 g/cm³，相對密度 0.90。 V=8π cm³=25.1327 cm³；m=7.8×0.90×8π=176.4318 g。模型尚未扣齒槽。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At fixed metal mass Vfinal/Vinitial=ρ initial/ρ final; isotropic linear ratio is the cube root of that volume ratio. Teaching relative density increases from 0.75 to 0.95; initial length 20 mm; neglect oxidation and anisotropy. Volume ratio=0.75/0.95=0.78947; Lfinal=20×(0.75/0.95)^(1/3)=18.485 mm, approximately 7.58% linear shrinkage.

Annular volume V=π(Do²−Di²)b/4 and m=ρ solid×relative density×V, with tooth spaces deducted separately. Synthetic equivalent annulus OD 60, ID 20, width 10 mm; solid density 7.8 g/cm³ and relative density 0.90. V=8 π cm³=25.1327 cm³; m=7.8×0.90×8 π=176.4318 g, before tooth-space subtraction.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
